title: Data Actions & Real-Time Triggers

toc.text: 4. Platform events: the Apex automation surface

html:
Data 360 is not a report warehouse — it is an action engine. Data actions and real-time triggers connect profile changes to CRM updates, flows, platform events, and external systems. This phase covers data action targets, flow-triggered data actions, real-time streaming insights, and the event-driven patterns this lab mirrors with DataActionHandlerService and the Data_Action_Event__e platform event.

Learning Objectives

By the end of this phase, you will be able to:

  • Explain what a data action is and choose its target (CRM, external, flow).
  • Configure a data action for a qualification/event with proper filters and idempotency.
  • Combine real-time calculated insights, dynamic segments, and data actions into a reactive flow.
  • Publish/subscribe to platform events from Apex for the automation surface.
  • Extend and test DataActionHandlerService and its event subscriber.

1. Data actions

A data action is a configured side-effect that fires when Data 360 data changes or a segment qualifies members. Target types:

TargetWhat happensTypical use
Flow / Data Cloud-triggered flowStarts an autolaunched Flow with the member dataUpdate Case/Lead, notify, orchestrate
Salesforce CRMUpsert/update records (Contact/Account/Lead/Case)Materialized enrichment (Phase 9)
Apex (invocable)Calls an invocable Apex methodCustom logic, logging
External system / webhookHTTP callout with JSON payloadLoyalty, ERP, messaging
Platform eventPublishes a Data 360 event for subscribersAsync processing, integrations

Data actions mirror Data Cloud condition events: Data Change, Segment Qualification, Real-Time Calculated Insight (an insight crossing a threshold). Each action lets you map the event fields into the target inputs.

2. Real-time triggers: the streaming chain

The "instant response" exam architecture is a four-hop chain (revisit from Phases 2/5/6/7):

text
streaming ingestion (Ingestion API)
   → streaming transform / real-time calculated insight (threshold crossing)
   → dynamic segment qualification (member joins "At-Risk")
   → data action (update Case + notify CSM)       ← this phase

Each hop must be streaming-capable or the chain degrades to batch. The exam tests which hop is blocking a real-time requirement — almost always it is a batch-only data source or a static segment upstream.

Trigger classification for data actions

  • Data change event — fires when a DMO record is created/updated (e.g. Case__dlm updated).
  • Segment qualification event — fires when an individual joins/leaves a segment (the "moment" trigger).
  • Real-time calculated insight event — fires when a streaming insight crosses a threshold value (new and MVP-important for moment marketing like churn alerts).

3. Designing idempotent, high-volume actions

Streaming actions can fire per member per event. Production and exam discipline:

  1. Filter early — restrict the source (members with the right category, event types) before the action starts.
  2. Idempotent effects — CRM updates should upsert on a stable key; external calls should carry a correlation id / batch id so replays dedupe.
  3. Bounded side effects — never 1 call per event if a flow/queue can batch; external webhooks get a member-batch payload.
  4. Observability — log every action run (audit object) with success/failure and counts; retry bounded failures.

The lab's contract: DataActionHandlerService.handleDataActionEvents(List<Data_Action_Event__e>) parses event payloads, guards on Limits.getCallouts(), performs the (simulated) action, and writes an Activation_Audit__c/log row. Its platform-event trigger delegates to the service, exactly like the reference repo's IntegrationEventSubscriberTrigger.

4. Platform events: the Apex automation surface

Platform events (*__e, publishBehavior = PublishAfterCommit) give Data 360-backed integrations an async, decoupled path:

apex
// Publishing (bulk, one publish call — never loop)
List<Data_Action_Event__e> events = new List<Data_Action_Event__e>();
for (Id memberId : memberIds) {
    events.add(new Data_Action_Event__e(
        Member_Key__c = String.valueOf(memberId),
        Action_Type__c = 'EnrichCase',
        Payload__c    = buildPayload(memberId)
    ));
}
Database.SaveResult[] sr = EventBus.publish(events);

Subscribers (Apex triggers on *__e) react asynchronously and re-enter the service layer via a recursion guard. This is how a "Data 360 event → Case update" can be built purely in Apex — and it is the same pattern the real product's "data action → Apex target" uses internally.

Recursion control: the subscriber trigger checks TriggerHandlerService.shouldRun('DataActionEventSubscriberTrigger') before delegating, so a re-entrant update cannot retrigger the same logic in one transaction.

Hands-On Exercises

Exercise 1: Action-target match

Match requirement → data action target: (a) "update Case.Priority when churn crosses 0.7", (b) "POST webhook to loyalty ERP", (c) "run a multi-step Flow that emails CSM", (d) "upsert Contact.Lifetime_Value".

Exercise 2: Chain audit

For the real-time churn service alert: list all four hops (ingestion → transform/insight → segment → action), name the Data 360 config element at each hop, and identify what breaks if the insight is batch-computed on a nightly schedule.

Exercise 3: Build the subscriber

Write DataActionEventSubscriberTrigger.trigger delegating to DataActionHandlerService.handleDataActionEvents(Trigger.new), guarded by TriggerHandlerService.shouldRun(...). Add a test that publishes 2 events, asserts exactly 2 audit rows, and asserts 0 DML loops recorded by the service.

Key Terms Glossary

TermDefinition
Data actionConfigured side-effect firing on Data 360 change/qualification/insight events.
Data change eventFires on DMO record create/update.
Segment qualification eventFires when an individual joins/leaves a segment.
Real-time calculated insightStreaming insight that fires when a measure crosses a threshold.
IdempotencySafe re-execution: replays update rather than duplicate.
Correlation id / batch idThe stable key carried in payloads for dedupe and tracing.
Platform event (__e)Publish/subscribe message bus on the Salesforce Platform.
PublishAfterCommitPlatform event behavior publishing after the transaction commits.

Certification Checkpoints

  • I can pick the right data action target for a requirement.
  • I can keep the real-time chain streaming end-to-end and name the breaking hop.
  • I can design idempotent, filtered, observable data actions.
  • I can publish and subscribe to platform events with bulk discipline and recursion guards.
  • I can extend and test DataActionHandlerService.

Self-Check

  1. Q: What fires when a member joins the "At-Risk" segment? — A: A segment qualification event, which a data action converts into a CRM update/flow/webhook.
  2. Q: Why is a nightly SUM insight incompatible with a churn alert? — A: The insight hop is batch; the whole real-time chain requires streaming data, a streaming transform/insight, and a dynamic segment.
  3. Q: How do you make a data action safe to replay? — A: Filter early, upsert on a stable key, carry a correlation/batch id, and log (audit) each run.
